comment: The grading fonts replay reference corpora through layout and SVG emission per font: glyph metrics and renders differ per face, so outcomes are recorded for each. Fetched to corpus/fonts/<id>/ by scripts/fetch-reference-corpus.sh; Cambria Math rides its TTC's second face (index 1).

fonts.description: Microsoft's Cambria Math face; fetch with fontist (fontist download cambria) and pin the file sha256.
